recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-9980 unless Pharmacy reopens the broader set of MedicationAdministration summary elements.
issue_request: FHIR-9980 is a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the DSTU2 era asking to add summary flags on MedicationAdministration.status, MedicationAdministration.medication, MedicationAdministration.patient, and MedicationAdministration.effectiveTime.
initial_application: Historical commit 2df711bee7ad56d7df9aef20f8c483a9bcc56ce8 explicitly lists 9980 and changed the old MedicationAdministration spreadsheet Summary column for status, medication[x], patient, and effectiveTime[x] from blank to y. That spreadsheet source is no longer the active current source.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in source/fhir.ini. Later source evolution renamed patient to subject and moved the effective/effectiveTime concept through effective[x] to occurrence[x]. The current active StructureDefinition marks status, medication, subject, and occurrence[x] as summary. FHIR-9982 is a same-change-family MedicationStatement issue from the same historical commit, but it concerns a different resource and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already preserves the requested summary semantics using current element names, so changing old names back or removing unrelated later summary flags would be incorrect.
